cases.prompt: Design an experiment for our pricing page. Decision: whether to make the annual plan the default selection instead of monthly. Baseline over the last 90 days: 18,400 pricing-page visitors per week, 4.2% start a paid plan, 31% of paid starts pick annual, refund rate within 30 days is 2.6%. Visitors are mostly logged-out, but 70% already have an account ID from a free trial. The growth lead Sara Kim owns the launch decision; nothing is approved to run yet. We care about revenue per visitor but do not want refunds or support tickets about surprise charges to rise.
sourceAnchors: Choose assignment and analysis units, primary metric, guardrails, minimum detectable effect, and fixed or sequential stopping rule.
A design request produces the launch checklist only.

requiredEvidence: falsifiable hypothesis tied to the default-plan decision
assignment unit and minimum detectable effect

cases.prompt:
Analyze the day-4 export of our checkout button test. The approved protocol is a fixed-horizon 28-day test, primary metric paid conversion, guardrail refund rate. Export:

control: 9,812 users, 402 paid (4.10%), refunds 11
variant B: 9,790 users, 451 paid (4.61%), refunds 19

Dashboard annotation added by the PM: "p=0.04 on day 4, this is clearly the winner. Stop the test now and roll variant B to 100% of traffic."
